prompt.role: Act as a senior protocol engineer helping me organize this practical exercise. Iam responsible to validate every technical decision.
prompt.task:
1- Read the practical exercise brief and inspect the repository. 2- Create a file: docs/execution-plan.md
This file will be the step by step execution plan I will follow for this exercise.
- Keep it concise, actionable and ordered. - Use the following workflow: Discovery => Validation => Implementation => Verification => Review and QA - Do not implement or modify source code yet
prompt.time_context:
Started: 2026-09-05 10:00 Planned lunch break: 12:00 Target effort: approximately 4 to 5 focused hours Aproximatelly Deadline: 2026-09-06 15:00
Do not assign fixed durations to individual phases. The phases must remain adaptive. Actual focused time will be recorded when completed.
prompt.execution_plan:
Organize it as checklists:
Discovery - inspect deployment topology, proxy, market, storage and tests - run build and tests - run Slither and Aderyn - manually inspect financially sensitive paths - record security hypotheses
Validation - prioritize hypotheses by potential financial/protocol impact - reproduce suspected defects with Foundry - reject hypotheses that cannot be demonstrated - classify confirmed findings by severity
Implementation - fix confirmed findings with minimal changes - implement the required reserve factor - preserve external interfaces - preserve storage/upgrade compatibility - avoid unrelated refactoring - run relevant tests after each change
Verification - confirm regression tests fail against vulnerable behavior and pass after fixes - add fuzz, invariant test - verify storage/upgrade safety - run the full Foundry suite - rerun relevant static analysis
Review and QA - review the complete diff - check every requirement from the exercise - finalize findings and severity - document reserve accounting decisions - document trade-offs, uncertainties and intentionally omitted work - finalize README - confirm repository is ready
prompt.output: - ecution-plan.md must be a working checklist - keep it short - each step should tell me what to do next and have a checkbox
prompt.critial: IMPORTANT: Do not implement or modify source code yet IMPORTANT: Do not populate findings before discovery IMPORTANT: Do not create other planning artifacts IMPORTANT: Do not implement code
